_comment: Networks for games ESPN records wrongly or not at all. Game id -> network names as ESPN writes them (FOX, CBS, ESPN, FS1, BTN, Peacock). These now REPLACE whatever ESPN says rather than only filling a blank (his call 2026-09-13: Oregon-Oklahoma State was listed as Disney+/ESPNEWS but was on ESPN). Read BEFORE the window rules run, so a network here can place a game in a window. Run `python harvest.py && python site.py` afterwards.
